title: Humyn Labs raises $47 mn to collect training data for physical AI
summary:
Bengaluru-based Humyn Labs has raised $47 million to collect real-world data from factories and homes to train AI and humanoid robots, amid growing concerns over privacy, consent and data sovereignty.

The post Humyn Labs raises $47 mn to collect training data for physical AI appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: Bengaluru‑based startup Humyn Labs has secured $47 million in funding to build a large‑scale dataset of real‑world sensor data from factories, homes and other physical environments. The data will be used to train AI models and humanoid robots, helping them understand and interact with the physical world more effectively. The effort raises fresh debates about privacy, consent and data sovereignty as machines learn from everyday human spaces.
